messages.content: What's the current traffic condition in New York?

function.name: geocode_address
function.description: Transforms a description of a location (like a pair of coordinates, an address, or a name of a place) to a location on the Earth's surface. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

address.description: The address that needs to be geocoded.

locale.description: Preferred locale for the returned address information. (Optional) Default: None

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live traffic data. I can help you find a map or give general advice on how to check traffic conditions in New York, but I can’t provide real‑time traffic updates. Let me know if there’s anything else I can do for you!

But we can use geocode_address to get location? But that only gives coordinates. There's no function to get traffic. We might respond that we cannot fetch real-time traffic. But maybe we can approximate by using geocode_address to get coordinates and then mention that we can't fetch traffic. The user likely expects a real-time traffic update. We don't have that capability. So we should explain limitation.
